name: The School's Headmaster
source:
Up until now, there has been no reason to visit his office. He is professional and polite, though he runs the school with an iron fist. He has an idea on how to improve your failing grades. If you can stomach the suggestion, that is.

[From [url=https://pridedrawing.itch.io/bound-to-college]official site[/url]]
